FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_SyncCondenser_ExcitationCooling
(*
====================================================================================================
  LUMINA SYNTHETIC IEC 61131-3 INDUSTRIAL CONTROL KERNEL - HIGH-INTEGRITY GENERATION
  COMPONENT : FB_SyncCondenser_ExcitationCooling
  DOMAIN    : 300-MVAR Grid Synchronous Condenser: Hydrogen Coolant Pressure Gradient 
              and Static Excitation Reactive Power Fast-Dispatch
  TARGET PLC: IEC 61131-3 Compliant Industrial Controller (TwinCAT 3 / ControlLogix / S7-1500)
  REVISION  : V7.4.2 Professional Automation Architecture
====================================================================================================
  SYSTEM TOPOLOGY & THEORETICAL PRINCIPLES:
  1. MACHINE TOPOLOGY:
     - 300 MVAR continuous rating (+300 MVAR capacitive over-excited / -150 MVAR inductive under-excited)
     - Stator: 22.0 kV line-to-line nominal, 7873 A RMS continuous nominal current.
     - Rotor: Pressurized hydrogen direct-radial-flow cooling via shaft-mounted multi-stage centrifugal fans.
     - Static Excitation System (SES): High-initial-response IEEE ST1A dual-bridge 12-pulse thyristor rectifier
       with full negative ceiling field-forcing capability for rapid de-excitation (inverter mode).
  
  2. HYDROGEN COOLANT THERMO-FLUID COUPLING & PRESSURE GRADIENTS:
     - Hydrogen gas at 4.14 bar (approx 60 psig) provides 7.2x the heat transfer rate of ambient air with 
       1/10th the windage drag friction, but requires rigorous pressure gradient control to maintain seal integrity.
     - Shaft Seal Oil Differential: Delta-P (P_oil - P_H2) must remain strictly within [0.35, 0.55] bar.
       If Delta-P falls below 0.25 bar, hydrogen gas blows out across seal faces, creating explosive risk.
       If Delta-P exceeds 0.70 bar, seal oil floods into the machine casing, degrading stator bar insulation.
     - Dynamic Thermal Capacity Scaling: Real-time MVAR capacity is continuously derated as a non-linear
       function of active casing pressure and cold-gas heat exchanger temperature:
         S_cap(t) = S_rated * ((P_H2(t) / P_H2_nom)^0.42) * SQRT((T_slot_max - T_cold(t)) / (T_slot_max - T_cold_nom))
  
  3. STATIC EXCITATION CONTROL (STATE-SPACE MPC / FAST VOLTAGE DISPATCH):
     - Discrete state-space tracking formulation for reactive power (Q) and terminal voltage (Vt) loops:
         x[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k] + L_obs * (y[k] - C_d * x[k])
         u[k]   = -K_lqr * x[k] + K_integral * integral_error_Q + u_feedforward
     - Fast Fault-Ride-Through (FRT) voltage support: If terminal voltage drops by > 10% (0.90 p.u.),
       the controller overrides standard AGC dispatch and transitions to fast reactive current injection
       (k_frt = 2.0 to 4.0 p.u. delta-I_q per delta-V_t) within < 20 ms to meet strict grid interconnection codes.
  
  4. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) VOTING:
     - Implemented on both critical 3-phase grid voltage measurements and hydrogen casing pressure sensors.
     - Mid-value select with tolerance deviation cross-checks and auto-degradation to 1oo2 or fail-safe.
====================================================================================================
*)

VAR_INPUT
    bMasterEnable               : BOOL;     (* [bool] Master system enable & permissive interlock chain *)
    bFastDispatchPermit         : BOOL;     (* [bool] Fast transient reactive power dispatch permissive from EMS/AGC *)
    rGridVoltage_L1_kV          : REAL;     (* [kV] Grid terminal line voltage transducer Phase L1 *)
    rGridVoltage_L2_kV          : REAL;     (* [kV] Grid terminal line voltage transducer Phase L2 *)
    rGridVoltage_L3_kV          : REAL;     (* [kV] Grid terminal line voltage transducer Phase L3 *)
    rGridFrequency_Hz           : REAL;     (* [Hz] Grid busbar electrical frequency *)
    rQ_Demand_MVAR              : REAL;     (* [MVAR] Active dispatch reactive power demand setpoint (-150.0 to +300.0) *)
    rStatorCurrent_RMS_A        : REAL;     (* [A] Total RMS stator line current from 22 kV current transformers *)
    rFieldCurrent_DC_A          : REAL;     (* [A] Main rotor field DC excitation current *)
    rFieldVoltage_DC_V          : REAL;     (* [V] Main rotor field DC terminal voltage *)
    rHydrogenPress_CH1_bar      : REAL;     (* [bar] Hydrogen casing pressure transmitter Channel 1 (3.00 to 5.00 bar) *)
    rHydrogenPress_CH2_bar      : REAL;     (* [bar] Hydrogen casing pressure transmitter Channel 2 (3.00 to 5.00 bar) *)
    rHydrogenPress_CH3_bar      : REAL;     (* [bar] Hydrogen casing pressure transmitter Channel 3 (3.00 to 5.00 bar) *)
    rSealOilDiffPress_bar       : REAL;     (* [bar] Shaft seal oil differential pressure over H2 (nominal 0.45 bar) *)
    rHydrogenPurity_Pct         : REAL;     (* [%] Casing hydrogen gas purity concentration analyzer *)
    rColdGasTemp_DegC           : REAL;     (* [deg C] Cold hydrogen gas temperature leaving heat exchangers *)
    rHotGasTemp_DegC            : REAL;     (* [deg C] Hot hydrogen gas discharge temperature from stator core *)
    rStatorSlotMaxTemp_DegC     : REAL;     (* [deg C] Maximum stator winding slot RTD temperature *)
    bEmergencyFastDeExcite      : BOOL;     (* [bool] Hardwired trip / emergency field suppression pulse *)
    tCycleTime                  : TIME := T#10MS; (* [ms] Discrete task cycle execution period *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    rFiringAngle_Alpha_Deg      : REAL;     (* [deg] Thyristor full-bridge firing delay angle (10.0 to 150.0 deg) *)
    rExciterVoltageCmd_V        : REAL;     (* [V] Commanded DC excitation voltage output to gate pulse generator *)
    rActualReactivePower_MVAR   : REAL;     (* [MVAR] Filtered instantaneous machine reactive power output *)
    rAvailableCapacity_MVAR     : REAL;     (* [MVAR] Dynamic thermal capability limit based on H2 pressure & cold gas *)
    rHydrogenDiffGradient_mbar  : REAL;     (* [mbar] Calculated cooling gas differential pressure across rotor fan *)
    wCondenserStatusWord        : WORD;     (* [word] Packed machine state, control mode, and operational status *)
    wAlarmStatusWord            : WORD;     (* [word] Packed alarm bitfield: sensor faults, thermal limits, pressure *)
    bFastInjectionActive        : BOOL;     (* [bool] Grid fault voltage support / fast reactive boost actively firing *)
    bCoolingDegradedDerate      : BOOL;     (* [bool] Active cooling constraint causing automatic MVAR curtailment *)
    bTripBreakerCmd             : BOOL;     (* [bool] Master trip command to 22 kV breaker & exciter field breaker *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- 2oo3 TMR Voting Variables --- *)
    rV_Grid_Voted_kV            : REAL;     (* Voted grid terminal line voltage [kV] *)
    rP_H2_Voted_bar             : REAL;     (* Voted hydrogen casing pressure [bar] *)
    bV_Grid_SensorFault         : BOOL;     (* True if one or more grid voltage sensors diverged *)
    bP_H2_SensorFault           : BOOL;     (* True if one or more H2 pressure sensors diverged *)
    iV_Grid_HealthySensors      : INT;      (* Count of valid grid voltage channels [0..3] *)
    iP_H2_HealthySensors        : INT;      (* Count of valid H2 pressure channels [0..3] *)
    rV_Grid_Dev_12              : REAL;     (* Inter-channel deviation Ch1-Ch2 [kV] *)
    rV_Grid_Dev_23              : REAL;     (* Inter-channel deviation Ch2-Ch3 [kV] *)
    rV_Grid_Dev_31              : REAL;     (* Inter-channel deviation Ch3-Ch1 [kV] *)
    rP_H2_Dev_12                : REAL;     (* Inter-channel deviation Ch1-Ch2 [bar] *)
    rP_H2_Dev_23                : REAL;     (* Inter-channel deviation Ch2-Ch3 [bar] *)
    rP_H2_Dev_31                : REAL;     (* Inter-channel deviation Ch3-Ch1 [bar] *)

    (* --- Thermodynamics & Cooling Gas Gradient Variables --- *)
    rNominalH2Press_bar         : REAL := 4.14;  (* Nominal casing hydrogen pressure [bar] *)
    rNominalColdGasTemp_DegC    : REAL := 38.0;  (* Nominal cold gas baseline temperature [deg C] *)
    rMaxAllowableSlotTemp_DegC  : REAL := 125.0; (* Class F insulation operating limit [deg C] *)
    rPressureRatio              : REAL;          (* Ratio of active H2 pressure to nominal *)
    rThermalTempMargin          : REAL;          (* Scaled temperature delta margin for cooling *)
    rGasDensity_kgm3            : REAL;          (* Density of pressurized H2 at operating temp [kg/m^3] *)
    rGasFanVolumeFlow_m3s       : REAL := 22.5;  (* Centrifugal rotor fan volumetric flow rate [m^3/s] *)
    rGasMassFlow_kgs            : REAL;          (* Hydrogen mass flow rate through stator/rotor ducts [kg/s] *)
    rCalculatedCoreLoss_kW      : REAL;          (* Real-time thermal dissipation estimated from losses [kW] *)

    (* --- State-Space Matrices & Observer (Linearized Discrete-Time System) --- *)
    (* State vector: x = [e_q_transient (kV), delta_omega (rad/s), delta_delta (rad), I_field (A)] *)
    a11 : REAL := 0.9852; a12 : REAL := -0.0124; a13 : REAL := -0.0341; a14 : REAL := 0.0048;
    a21 : REAL := 0.0082; a22 : REAL :=  0.9715; a23 : REAL := -0.0628; a24 : REAL := 0.0011;
    a31 : REAL := 0.0004; a32 : REAL :=  0.0098; a33 : REAL :=  0.9996; a34 : REAL := 0.0001;
    a41 : REAL :=-0.0421; a42 : REAL :=  0.0156; a43 : REAL :=  0.0210; a44 : REAL := 0.8920;

    b1 : REAL := 0.00125;
    b2 : REAL := 0.00031;
    b3 : REAL := 0.00002;
    b4 : REAL := 0.03850;

    (* Observer Gain Matrix L (Kalman Filter steady-state gains for terminal voltage feedback) *)
    l1 : REAL := 0.1420;
    l2 : REAL := 0.0215;
    l3 : REAL := 0.0048;
    l4 : REAL := 0.3850;

    (* State Feedback / MPC Control Gain Vector K *)
    k1 : REAL := 18.520;
    k2 : REAL := 4.1200;
    k3 : REAL := 12.850;
    k4 : REAL := 0.1850;

    (* Estimated States *)
    rX_Hat_1                    : REAL := 22.0; (* Estimated transient EMF Eq prime [kV] *)
    rX_Hat_2                    : REAL := 0.0;  (* Estimated speed deviation Delta Omega [rad/s] *)
    rX_Hat_3                    : REAL := 0.0;  (* Estimated power angle deviation Delta Delta [rad] *)
    rX_Hat_4                    : REAL := 1250.0;(* Estimated rotor field current [A] *)

    (* State Update Intermediates *)
    rX_Next_1                   : REAL;
    rX_Next_2                   : REAL;
    rX_Next_3                   : REAL;
    rX_Next_4                   : REAL;
    rY_Model_kV                 : REAL;
    rObsError_kV                : REAL;

    (* --- Reactive Power Tracking & Control Variables --- *)
    rEffective_Q_Demand_MVAR    : REAL;     (* Post-limiter reactive power demand target *)
    rQ_Error_MVAR               : REAL;     (* Reactive power tracking error *)
    rQ_IntegralAccumulator      : REAL;     (* Reset-stabilized integrator for zero steady-state error *)
    rKi_Q                       : REAL := 0.045; (* Integral gain for reactive power regulator *)
    rKp_Q                       : REAL := 0.850; (* Proportional gain for reactive power regulator *)
    rUnsaturatedExciterCmd_V    : REAL;     (* Raw exciter output prior to thyristor ceiling clamps *)
    rCeilingVoltage_Positive_V  : REAL := 650.0;  (* Positive forcing ceiling voltage (ST1A bridge) [V] *)
    rCeilingVoltage_Negative_V  : REAL := -520.0; (* Negative forcing ceiling voltage (inverter mode) [V] *)

    (* --- Grid Code & Fast Fault Ride-Through (FRT) Parameters --- *)
    rGridVoltage_Nominal_kV     : REAL := 22.0; (* Nominal terminal bus voltage [kV] *)
    rVoltageDeviation_PU        : REAL;         (* Voltage deviation from nominal in per-unit *)
    rFastInjectionGain_K_frt    : REAL := 3.0;  (* Reactive current injection slope per grid code *)
    rFastReactiveBoost_MVAR     : REAL;         (* Dynamic fast boost injected during dips *)
    tFRT_DurationTimer          : TON;          (* FRT duration pulse timer *)
    tFRT_HoldoffTimer           : TON;          (* Holdoff timer after FRT before AGC release *)

    (* --- Limiters Stack (OEL, UEL, V/Hz) --- *)
    (* Overexcitation Limiter (OEL) Inverse-Time Thermal Model *)
    rFieldCurrentRated_A        : REAL := 1420.0; (* Continuous rated field current [A] *)
    rFieldThermalOverload_I2t   : REAL := 0.0;    (* Thermal accumulator sum for rotor field *)
    rThermalCoolingRate_I2t     : REAL := 12.5;   (* Decay rate of rotor thermal storage *)
    bOEL_Active                 : BOOL;           (* Overexcitation Limiter clamping active *)

    (* Underexcitation Limiter (UEL) *)
    rUEL_Threshold_MVAR         : REAL := -150.0; (* Base UEL limit at nominal voltage *)
    rDynamic_UEL_MVAR           : REAL;           (* Stability-adjusted UEL threshold *)
    bUEL_Active                 : BOOL;           (* Underexcitation Limiter clamping active *)

    (* Volts/Hertz Flux Saturation Limiter *)
    rV_Hz_Ratio_PU              : REAL;           (* Voltage to Frequency ratio in per-unit *)
    bVHz_LimitActive            : BOOL;           (* Volts/Hertz overfluxing limiter active *)

    (* --- Finite State Machine Execution --- *)
    iMachineState               : INT := 0;       (* Main operational regime state index *)
    tStateTimer                 : TON;            (* Multi-purpose state dwell timer *)
    tPurgeTimer                 : TON;            (* Pre-start casing seal oil stabilization timer *)

    (* Internal Diagnostics *)
    rCycleTime_Sec              : REAL;           (* Converted cycle time for digital integrators [s] *)
    iLoopCounter                : UDINT := 0;     (* Diagnostic deterministic iteration counter *)
END_VAR

(*
====================================================================================================
  CONTROLLER COMPUTATIONAL PIPELINE
====================================================================================================
*)

(* Convert cycle time from IEC TIME to REAL seconds *)
rCycleTime_Sec := TIME_TO_REAL(tCycleTime) / 1000.0;
IF rCycleTime_Sec <= 0.001 THEN
    rCycleTime_Sec := 0.010; (* Default to 10 ms if invalid cycle time specified *)
END_IF;

iLoopCounter := iLoopCounter + 1;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-ROUTINE 1: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) VOTING ENGINE
   Executes mid-value selection and inter-channel cross-comparison with automatic sensor health audit.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Channel Deviations for 22 kV Grid Voltage Transducers *)
rV_Grid_Dev_12 := ABS(rGridVoltage_L1_kV - rGridVoltage_L2_kV);
rV_Grid_Dev_23 := ABS(rGridVoltage_L2_kV - rGridVoltage_L3_kV);
rV_Grid_Dev_31 := ABS(rGridVoltage_L3_kV - rGridVoltage_L1_kV);

iV_Grid_HealthySensors := 3;
IF (rV_Grid_Dev_12 > 1.5) AND (rV_Grid_Dev_31 > 1.5) THEN
    (* Channel 1 diverges from both Ch2 and Ch3 *)
    iV_Grid_HealthySensors := 2;
    rV_Grid_Voted_kV := (rGridVoltage_L2_kV + rGridVoltage_L3_kV) * 0.5;
    bV_Grid_SensorFault := TRUE;
ELSIF (rV_Grid_Dev_12 > 1.5) AND (rV_Grid_Dev_23 > 1.5) THEN
    (* Channel 2 diverges from both Ch1 and Ch3 *)
    iV_Grid_HealthySensors := 2;
    rV_Grid_Voted_kV := (rGridVoltage_L1_kV + rGridVoltage_L3_kV) * 0.5;
    bV_Grid_SensorFault := TRUE;
ELSIF (rV_Grid_Dev_23 > 1.5) AND (rV_Grid_Dev_31 > 1.5) THEN
    (* Channel 3 diverges from both Ch1 and Ch2 *)
    iV_Grid_HealthySensors := 2;
    rV_Grid_Voted_kV := (rGridVoltage_L1_kV + rGridVoltage_L2_kV) * 0.5;
    bV_Grid_SensorFault := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* All channels within tolerance: Median Selection *)
    IF ((rGridVoltage_L1_kV >= rGridVoltage_L2_kV) AND (rGridVoltage_L1_kV <= rGridVoltage_L3_kV)) OR 
       ((rGridVoltage_L1_kV <= rGridVoltage_L2_kV) AND (rGridVoltage_L1_kV >= rGridVoltage_L3_kV)) THEN
        rV_Grid_Voted_kV := rGridVoltage_L1_kV;
    ELSIF ((rGridVoltage_L2_kV >= rGridVoltage_L1_kV) AND (rGridVoltage_L2_kV <= rGridVoltage_L3_kV)) OR 
          ((rGridVoltage_L2_kV <= rGridVoltage_L1_kV) AND (rGridVoltage_L2_kV >= rGridVoltage_L3_kV)) THEN
        rV_Grid_Voted_kV := rGridVoltage_L2_kV;
    ELSE
        rV_Grid_Voted_kV := rGridVoltage_L3_kV;
    END_IF;
    bV_Grid_SensorFault := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Channel Deviations for Hydrogen Casing Pressure Transducers *)
rP_H2_Dev_12 := ABS(rHydrogenPress_CH1_bar - rHydrogenPress_CH2_bar);
rP_H2_Dev_23 := ABS(rHydrogenPress_CH2_bar - rHydrogenPress_CH3_bar);
rP_H2_Dev_31 := ABS(rHydrogenPress_CH3_bar - rHydrogenPress_CH1_bar);

iP_H2_HealthySensors := 3;
IF (rP_H2_Dev_12 > 0.25) AND (rP_H2_Dev_31 > 0.25) THEN
    iP_H2_HealthySensors := 2;
    rP_H2_Voted_bar := (rHydrogenPress_CH2_bar + rHydrogenPress_CH3_bar) * 0.5;
    bP_H2_SensorFault := TRUE;
ELSIF (rP_H2_Dev_12 > 0.25) AND (rP_H2_Dev_23 > 0.25) THEN
    iP_H2_HealthySensors := 2;
    rP_H2_Voted_bar := (rHydrogenPress_CH1_bar + rHydrogenPress_CH3_bar) * 0.5;
    bP_H2_SensorFault := TRUE;
ELSIF (rP_H2_Dev_23 > 0.25) AND (rP_H2_Dev_31 > 0.25) THEN
    iP_H2_HealthySensors := 2;
    rP_H2_Voted_bar := (rHydrogenPress_CH1_bar + rHydrogenPress_CH2_bar) * 0.5;
    bP_H2_SensorFault := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Median Selection for Hydrogen Pressure *)
    IF ((rHydrogenPress_CH1_bar >= rHydrogenPress_CH2_bar) AND (rHydrogenPress_CH1_bar <= rHydrogenPress_CH3_bar)) OR 
       ((rHydrogenPress_CH1_bar <= rHydrogenPress_CH2_bar) AND (rHydrogenPress_CH1_bar >= rHydrogenPress_CH3_bar)) THEN
        rP_H2_Voted_bar := rHydrogenPress_CH1_bar;
    ELSIF ((rHydrogenPress_CH2_bar >= rHydrogenPress_CH1_bar) AND (rHydrogenPress_CH2_bar <= rHydrogenPress_CH3_bar)) OR 
          ((rHydrogenPress_CH2_bar <= rHydrogenPress_CH1_bar) AND (rHydrogenPress_CH2_bar >= rHydrogenPress_CH3_bar)) THEN
        rP_H2_Voted_bar := rHydrogenPress_CH2_bar;
    ELSE
        rP_H2_Voted_bar := rHydrogenPress_CH3_bar;
    END_IF;
    bP_H2_SensorFault := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-ROUTINE 2: HYDROGEN COOLANT THERMODYNAMICS & DYNAMIC MVAR DERATING
   Computes coolant gas density, mass flow rate, rotor blower pressure gradient, and thermal capacity.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Ideal gas law modified for hydrogen: rho = (P * M) / (Z * R_u * T) *)
(* At 4.14 bar absolute and 38 deg C, rho_H2 is approximately 0.32 kg/m^3 *)
IF rColdGasTemp_DegC > -20.0 THEN
    rGasDensity_kgm3 := ((rP_H2_Voted_bar + 1.013) * 100000.0 * 0.002016) / (8.314 * (rColdGasTemp_DegC + 273.15));
ELSE
    rGasDensity_kgm3 := 0.32;
END_IF;

(* Mass flow rate circulating through rotor end-bell vents *)
rGasMassFlow_kgs := rGasFanVolumeFlow_m3s * rGasDensity_kgm3;

(* Rotor centrifugal blower pressure rise gradient across core iron ducts [mbar] *)
(* Delta_P_fan = 0.5 * rho * (omega * r)^2 * fan_efficiency *)
rHydrogenDiffGradient_mbar := (0.5 * rGasDensity_kgm3 * 8200.0 * 0.72) / 100.0;

(* Dynamic Thermal Derating Ratio based on IEC 60034-3 Hydrogen Curve *)
IF (rNominalH2Press_bar > 0.5) AND (rP_H2_Voted_bar > 0.5) THEN
    rPressureRatio := rP_H2_Voted_bar / rNominalH2Press_bar;
ELSE
    rPressureRatio := 0.5;
END_IF;

IF rPressureRatio > 1.15 THEN
    rPressureRatio := 1.15; (* Cap credit at +15% over nominal pressure *)
ELSIF rPressureRatio < 0.60 THEN
    rPressureRatio := 0.60; (* Deep derate lower bound *)
END_IF;

(* Cold gas temperature correction *)
IF rColdGasTemp_DegC < rMaxAllowableSlotTemp_DegC THEN
    rThermalTempMargin := (rMaxAllowableSlotTemp_DegC - rColdGasTemp_DegC) / 
                          (rMaxAllowableSlotTemp_DegC - rNominalColdGasTemp_DegC);
ELSE
    rThermalTempMargin := 0.10;
END_IF;

IF rThermalTempMargin > 1.25 THEN
    rThermalTempMargin := 1.25;
ELSIF rThermalTempMargin < 0.20 THEN
    rThermalTempMargin := 0.20;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Maximum Continuous Over-Excited MVAR Capability *)
rAvailableCapacity_MVAR := 300.0 * (EXPT(rPressureRatio, 0.42)) * SQRT(rThermalTempMargin);

(* Activate Cooling Derated Flag if available capacity is clamped below 95% rated *)
bCoolingDegradedDerate := (rAvailableCapacity_MVAR < 285.0) OR (rP_H2_Voted_bar < 3.80);

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-ROUTINE 3: GRID FAULT DETECTION & FAST REACTIVE POWER INJECTION (FRT)
   Sub-cycle detection of terminal voltage depressions and dynamic voltage support dispatch.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rVoltageDeviation_PU := (rV_Grid_Voted_kV - rGridVoltage_Nominal_kV) / rGridVoltage_Nominal_kV;

(* High-speed grid code detection: Fault ride-through triggers if V < 0.90 p.u. or V > 1.10 p.u. *)
IF (rVoltageDeviation_PU < -0.10) AND bFastDispatchPermit AND (iMachineState >= 40) THEN
    bFastInjectionActive := TRUE;
    (* Dynamic reactive boost: Delta_Q = -K_frt * Delta_V * S_rated *)
    rFastReactiveBoost_MVAR := -rFastInjectionGain_K_frt * rVoltageDeviation_PU * 300.0;
    IF rFastReactiveBoost_MVAR > 200.0 THEN
        rFastReactiveBoost_MVAR := 200.0; (* Limit transient boost headroom to 200 MVAR additional *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bFastInjectionActive := FALSE;
    rFastReactiveBoost_MVAR := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-ROUTINE 4: ADVANCED LIMITERS STACK (OEL, UEL, VOLTS/HERTZ)
   Protects rotor field, stator core laminations, and end-region structural iron from thermal damage.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 1. Overexcitation Limiter (OEL) Inverse-Time Thermal Model: Integral of (I_f^2 - I_f_rated^2) dt *)
IF rFieldCurrent_DC_A > rFieldCurrentRated_A THEN
    rFieldThermalOverload_I2t := rFieldThermalOverload_I2t + 
        (((rFieldCurrent_DC_A * rFieldCurrent_DC_A) - (rFieldCurrentRated_A * rFieldCurrentRated_A)) * rCycleTime_Sec);
    IF rFieldThermalOverload_I2t > 150000.0 THEN
        bOEL_Active := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rFieldThermalOverload_I2t := rFieldThermalOverload_I2t - (rThermalCoolingRate_I2t * rCycleTime_Sec * 1000.0);
    IF rFieldThermalOverload_I2t <= 0.0 THEN
        rFieldThermalOverload_I2t := 0.0;
        bOEL_Active := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* 2. Underexcitation Limiter (UEL): Prevent end-turn core heating and loss of synchronism *)
(* UEL limit expands with terminal voltage squared *)
rDynamic_UEL_MVAR := rUEL_Threshold_MVAR * ((rV_Grid_Voted_kV / rGridVoltage_Nominal_kV) * (rV_Grid_Voted_kV / rGridVoltage_Nominal_kV));
IF rQ_Demand_MVAR < rDynamic_UEL_MVAR THEN
    bUEL_Active := TRUE;
ELSE
    bUEL_Active := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 3. Volts/Hertz Flux Saturation Limiter: Ratio = (V_pu) / (f_pu) *)
IF rGridFrequency_Hz > 10.0 THEN
    rV_Hz_Ratio_PU := (rV_Grid_Voted_kV / rGridVoltage_Nominal_kV) / (rGridFrequency_Hz / 50.0);
ELSE
    rV_Hz_Ratio_PU := 1.0;
END_IF;

bVHz_LimitActive := (rV_Hz_Ratio_PU > 1.12);

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-ROUTINE 5: COMPOSITE REACTIVE POWER TARGET & MPC STATE-SPACE REGULATOR
   Evaluates full-order state observer, predictive feedback, and computes thyristor firing angle alpha.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute composite reactive demand factoring in external dispatch, fast FRT boost, and limiters *)
rEffective_Q_Demand_MVAR := rQ_Demand_MVAR + rFastReactiveBoost_MVAR;

(* Apply dynamic OEL and UEL clamps *)
IF bOEL_Active THEN
    IF rEffective_Q_Demand_MVAR > 150.0 THEN
        rEffective_Q_Demand_MVAR := 150.0; (* Derate to 50% capacity during field thermal alarm *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF rEffective_Q_Demand_MVAR > rAvailableCapacity_MVAR THEN
    rEffective_Q_Demand_MVAR := rAvailableCapacity_MVAR;
END_IF;

IF rEffective_Q_Demand_MVAR < rDynamic_UEL_MVAR THEN
    rEffective_Q_Demand_MVAR := rDynamic_UEL_MVAR;
END_IF;

(* Instantaneous reactive power feedback: Q = SQRT(3) * V_L * I_S * sin(phi) *)
(* Here calculated from voltage, current, and excitation flux state *)
rActualReactivePower_MVAR := (1.73205 * rV_Grid_Voted_kV * rStatorCurrent_RMS_A * 0.995) / 1000.0;
IF rFieldCurrent_DC_A < 600.0 THEN
    rActualReactivePower_MVAR := -rActualReactivePower_MVAR; (* Under-excited quadrant *)
END_IF;

(* Tracking Error and Anti-Windup Integral Accumulator *)
rQ_Error_MVAR := rEffective_Q_Demand_MVAR - rActualReactivePower_MVAR;
IF (iMachineState = 40) OR (iMachineState = 50) THEN
    rQ_IntegralAccumulator := rQ_IntegralAccumulator + (rKi_Q * rQ_Error_MVAR * rCycleTime_Sec);
    (* Clamp integral accumulator to +/- 180 V *)
    IF rQ_IntegralAccumulator > 180.0 THEN
        rQ_IntegralAccumulator := 180.0;
    ELSIF rQ_IntegralAccumulator < -180.0 THEN
        rQ_IntegralAccumulator := -180.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rQ_IntegralAccumulator := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Full-State Observer Measurement Output Calculation: y_hat = C * x_hat *)
rY_Model_kV := rX_Hat_1;
rObsError_kV := rV_Grid_Voted_kV - rY_Model_kV;

(* Observer State Advance: x_hat[k+1] = A * x_hat[k] + B * u[k] + L * (y - y_hat) *)
rX_Next_1 := (a11 * rX_Hat_1) + (a12 * rX_Hat_2) + (a13 * rX_Hat_3) + (a14 * rX_Hat_4) + 
             (b1 * rFieldVoltage_DC_V) + (l1 * rObsError_kV);
rX_Next_2 := (a21 * rX_Hat_1) + (a22 * rX_Hat_2) + (a23 * rX_Hat_3) + (a24 * rX_Hat_4) + 
             (b2 * rFieldVoltage_DC_V) + (l2 * rObsError_kV);
rX_Next_3 := (a31 * rX_Hat_1) + (a32 * rX_Hat_2) + (a33 * rX_Hat_3) + (a34 * rX_Hat_4) + 
             (b3 * rFieldVoltage_DC_V) + (l3 * rObsError_kV);
rX_Next_4 := (a41 * rX_Hat_1) + (a42 * rX_Hat_2) + (a43 * rX_Hat_3) + (a44 * rX_Hat_4) + 
             (b4 * rFieldVoltage_DC_V) + (l4 * rObsError_kV);

rX_Hat_1 := rX_Next_1;
rX_Hat_2 := rX_Next_2;
rX_Hat_3 := rX_Next_3;
rX_Hat_4 := rX_Next_4;

(* State Feedback Control Law: u = -K * x + Kp * e_Q + Integral_Q + feedforward *)
rUnsaturatedExciterCmd_V := -((k1 * (rX_Hat_1 - rGridVoltage_Nominal_kV)) + 
                              (k2 * rX_Hat_2) + 
                              (k3 * rX_Hat_3) + 
                              (k4 * (rX_Hat_4 - rFieldCurrentRated_A))) + 
                             (rKp_Q * rQ_Error_MVAR) + 
                             rQ_IntegralAccumulator + 
                             280.0; (* 280 V nominal no-load field excitation bias *)

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-ROUTINE 6: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)
   Comprehensive management of start-up permissives, gas cooling, synchronization, and emergency paths.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iMachineState OF

    0: (* STATE: STANDBY_INHIBITED *)
        bTripBreakerCmd := FALSE;
        rExciterVoltageCmd_V := 0.0;
        rFiringAngle_Alpha_Deg := 150.0; (* Full inverter hold - non-conducting *)
        IF bMasterEnable THEN
            iMachineState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE: PURGE_SEAL_VERIFICATION *)
        (* Enforce strict hydrogen purity and seal oil differential before rotating excitation *)
        IF (rSealOilDiffPress_bar >= 0.35) AND (rSealOilDiffPress_bar <= 0.58) AND
           (rHydrogenPurity_Pct >= 96.0) THEN
            tPurgeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
            IF tPurgeTimer.Q THEN
                tPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iMachineState := 20;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
                iMachineState := 0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE: H2_PRESSURIZATION_CHECK *)
        (* Verify stable 2oo3 casing pressure gradient and cold gas baseline *)
        IF (rP_H2_Voted_bar >= 3.60) AND (rColdGasTemp_DegC <= 45.0) AND (iP_H2_HealthySensors >= 2) THEN
            iMachineState := 30;
        ELSE
            IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
                iMachineState := 0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE: SYNCHRONIZED_UNLOADED *)
        (* Machine synchronized to 22 kV bus; idling at 0 MVAR waiting for dispatch request *)
        rExciterVoltageCmd_V := 280.0; (* Base open-circuit field voltage *)
        rFiringAngle_Alpha_Deg := 65.0;
        IF bFastDispatchPermit AND (ABS(rQ_Demand_MVAR) > 1.0) THEN
            iMachineState := 40;
        ELSIF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iMachineState := 0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE: FAST_DISPATCH_MPC_ACTIVE *)
        (* Closed-loop high-speed state-space regulation with active thermal constraints *)
        rExciterVoltageCmd_V := rUnsaturatedExciterCmd_V;

        (* Clamp to physical bridge ceiling voltages *)
        IF rExciterVoltageCmd_V > rCeilingVoltage_Positive_V THEN
            rExciterVoltageCmd_V := rCeilingVoltage_Positive_V;
        ELSIF rExciterVoltageCmd_V < rCeilingVoltage_Negative_V THEN
            rExciterVoltageCmd_V := rCeilingVoltage_Negative_V;
        END_IF;

        (* Calculate firing angle: alpha = arccos(V_cmd / V_ceiling) *)
        (* Scaled linear approximation across industrial thyristor characteristic *)
        rFiringAngle_Alpha_Deg := 90.0 - ((rExciterVoltageCmd_V / rCeilingVoltage_Positive_V) * 75.0);
        IF rFiringAngle_Alpha_Deg < 10.0 THEN
            rFiringAngle_Alpha_Deg := 10.0;
        ELSIF rFiringAngle_Alpha_Deg > 150.0 THEN
            rFiringAngle_Alpha_Deg := 150.0;
        END_IF;

        (* State Transitions *)
        IF bFastInjectionActive THEN
            iMachineState := 50; (* Transition to transient FRT forcing *)
        ELSIF bCoolingDegradedDerate THEN
            iMachineState := 60; (* Transition to derated thermal management *)
        ELSIF (iV_Grid_HealthySensors < 2) OR (iP_H2_HealthySensors < 2) THEN
            iMachineState := 70; (* Transition to degraded manual regulation *)
        ELSIF NOT bFastDispatchPermit THEN
            iMachineState := 30; (* Revert to unloaded floating state *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE: TRANSIENT_FAULT_RIDE_THROUGH *)
        (* Full positive ceiling excitation forcing: alpha = 10 deg *)
        rExciterVoltageCmd_V := rCeilingVoltage_Positive_V;
        rFiringAngle_Alpha_Deg := 10.0;
        tFRT_DurationTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1200MS);

        IF tFRT_DurationTimer.Q OR (NOT bFastInjectionActive) THEN
            tFRT_DurationTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iMachineState := 40; (* Return to closed-loop dispatch *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE: THERMAL_OVERLOAD_DERATE *)
        (* Hydrogen cooling constrained or slot RTD excessive; ramp down excitation *)
        rExciterVoltageCmd_V := rUnsaturatedExciterCmd_V;
        IF rExciterVoltageCmd_V > 340.0 THEN
            rExciterVoltageCmd_V := 340.0; (* Clamp ceiling to nominal full-load equivalent *)
        END_IF;
        rFiringAngle_Alpha_Deg := 90.0 - ((rExciterVoltageCmd_V / rCeilingVoltage_Positive_V) * 75.0);

        IF (NOT bCoolingDegradedDerate) AND (rStatorSlotMaxTemp_DegC < 110.0) THEN
            iMachineState := 40; (* Recovered cooling capacity *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE: DEGRADED_MANUAL_EXC *)
        (* Redundant sensors lost: fallback to conservative open-loop voltage trim *)
        rExciterVoltageCmd_V := 280.0 + (rQ_Demand_MVAR * 0.40);
        IF rExciterVoltageCmd_V > 400.0 THEN
            rExciterVoltageCmd_V := 400.0;
        ELSIF rExciterVoltageCmd_V < 150.0 THEN
            rExciterVoltageCmd_V := 150.0;
        END_IF;
        rFiringAngle_Alpha_Deg := 90.0 - ((rExciterVoltageCmd_V / rCeilingVoltage_Positive_V) * 75.0);

        IF (iV_Grid_HealthySensors >= 2) AND (iP_H2_HealthySensors >= 2) THEN
            iMachineState := 40; (* Sensors restored, resume MPC closed loop *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE: EMERGENCY_FIELD_SUPPRESSION *)
        (* Invert thyristor bridge (alpha = 150 deg) to rapidly extract stored rotor magnetic energy *)
        rExciterVoltageCmd_V := rCeilingVoltage_Negative_V;
        rFiringAngle_Alpha_Deg := 150.0;
        IF rFieldCurrent_DC_A < 25.0 THEN
            bTripBreakerCmd := TRUE; (* Stored energy dissipated, open breakers *)
            iMachineState := 99;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE: LOCKOUT_TRIP *)
        rExciterVoltageCmd_V := 0.0;
        rFiringAngle_Alpha_Deg := 150.0;
        bTripBreakerCmd := TRUE;
        IF (NOT bMasterEnable) AND (NOT bEmergencyFastDeExcite) THEN
            iMachineState := 0; (* Reset lockout once master permissive cleared *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-ROUTINE 7: HARDWARE SAFETY INTERLOCKS & IMMEDIATE TRIP MONITORING
   Monitors explosive gas envelope, seal oil delta-P collapse, and extreme thermal runaway.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bEmergencyFastDeExcite OR 
   (rSealOilDiffPress_bar < 0.25) OR 
   (rSealOilDiffPress_bar > 0.75) OR 
   (rHydrogenPurity_Pct < 90.0) OR 
   (rStatorSlotMaxTemp_DegC > 140.0) OR 
   bVHz_LimitActive THEN
    IF iMachineState < 90 THEN
        iMachineState := 90; (* Trigger emergency de-excitation inversion *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SUB-ROUTINE 8: PACKED STATUS & ALARM BITFIELDS
   Provides deterministic telemetry words for SCADA / DCS communication protocols.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Status Word bit mapping *)
wCondenserStatusWord.0 := bMasterEnable;
wCondenserStatusWord.1 := (iMachineState = 40); (* Automatic Fast Dispatch Running *)
wCondenserStatusWord.2 := bFastInjectionActive;
wCondenserStatusWord.3 := bCoolingDegradedDerate;
wCondenserStatusWord.4 := bOEL_Active;
wCondenserStatusWord.5 := bUEL_Active;
wCondenserStatusWord.6 := (iMachineState = 70); (* Degraded Manual Mode *)
wCondenserStatusWord.7 := bTripBreakerCmd;

(* Alarm Word bit mapping *)
wAlarmStatusWord.0 := bV_Grid_SensorFault;
wAlarmStatusWord.1 := bP_H2_SensorFault;
wAlarmStatusWord.2 := (rSealOilDiffPress_bar < 0.32) OR (rSealOilDiffPress_bar > 0.62);
wAlarmStatusWord.3 := (rHydrogenPurity_Pct < 95.0);
wAlarmStatusWord.4 := (rColdGasTemp_DegC > 46.0);
wAlarmStatusWord.5 := (rStatorSlotMaxTemp_DegC > 125.0);
wAlarmStatusWord.6 := bOEL_Active;
wAlarmStatusWord.7 := bVHz_LimitActive;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
